metadata.title: COSU Exam Terminal Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Exam Terminals as high-integrity, single-purpose endpoint execution environments for assessments.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint designed exclusively for secure examination delivery and assessment workflows, with strong anti-tamper controls and no general-purpose computing capability.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Exam Terminals inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to an approved exam delivery application or secure assessment shell.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Candidate authentication is session-bound for exam delivery and does not persist beyond the assessment session.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Exam Terminals are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Exam Terminals are centrally enrolled, managed, and reset between sessions.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used to establish terminal authenticity and exam platform trust, not data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables shell access, external boot, local storage, removable media, copy/paste, printing, and screen capture.

props.name: anti-tamper-controls
props.remarks: Anti-tamper protections prevent application switching, debugging, local privilege escalation, and runtime modification.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is restricted to approved exam delivery platforms and management services.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Assessment data is not persisted locally beyond the exam session; terminals are cleared or reimaged between uses.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Exam Terminals may participate only in assessment workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: High exam integrity controls do not imply eligibility for higher-classification institutional data.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Terminal integrity, application state, and tamper events are continuously monitored and reported.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Exam Terminals support deterministic reset, periodic reimage, and audit-capable lifecycle workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Exam Terminals implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on assessment integrity, anti-tamper enforcement, and rapid recovery.

roles.title: Examination Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, configuration, monitoring, and reset of Exam Terminals.

roles.title: Assessment Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Approves exam terminal use cases, platform integrations, and exception handling.

control-implementation.remarks: Exam Terminal implementations are OS-specific (e.g., Windows Assigned Access, Linux locked shells, macOS Single App Mode) and are maintained as tightly controlled configuration artifacts.
